baseline.scope: src/eslams; full pytest including packaged provenance; Python 3.9.6

issues.title: [oss][feature] Add LABS.md Quickstart for BYO-key lab runs
issues.criterion: Close after one tested keyless/BYO-key lab guide lands with honest availability and trust claims; absorb #13/#18/#31 rather than keep three overlapping entry points.

issues.title: [oss][chore] Classify good/bad samples for GitHub+HF dual-home
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Choose current sample classification and custody policy; replace obsolete GOOD/BAD requirements. Sample metadata validation cannot authorize hidden-suite publication or prove byte-level scrubbing.

issues.title: [oss][chore] Add /labs page contract for Platform
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Decide whether /labs is a supported product goal. A Core handoff contract can close this scoped issue only after owner agreement; implementing hosted routes belongs to Platform.

issues.title: `eslams agent test` always reports "ok": true / exit 0, even when the agent is unreachable or returns illegal actions
issues.criterion: Agent-test ok/exit status must reflect unreachable/illegal responses; test successful, transport-failed and illegal-action agents using local fixtures.

issues.title: Documented `mypy src` / `mypy src/eslams` fails on Python >=3.10 (pyproject python_version=3.9 + anyio 4.15 `match` syntax)
issues.criterion: Use version-matched mypy configuration/tool compatibility and test the exact documented command on each supported Python, rather than ignoring dependency parse errors.

issues.title: `twine check` fails on a fresh build with the dev-extra twine (<7): '2.5' is not a valid metadata version
issues.criterion: Build fresh wheel/sdist, require a Twine version that supports generated metadata, and run twine check on both. No PyPI publication is necessary to verify this.

issues.title: CLI prints raw Python tracebacks for ordinary user errors (unknown agent/arena, missing file, bad JSON)
issues.criterion: Keep open; require console-entry-point handling and actual installed-command verification.
issues.evidence: Shared console/module CLI wrapper reports expected input/file errors, preserves unexpected failures, supports ESLAMS_DEBUG and handles closed output pipes. Six subprocess/error regressions plus output/archive regressions passed (30 cases); installed-wheel verification remains a final gate.

issues.title: `eslams run` exits 0 when the run is invalid for scoring (e.g. provider auth failure)
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Define CLI execution exit status separately from scoring eligibility. Retaining exit 0 for a completed diagnostic run is defensible if clearly documented; add an explicit strict mode if needed without silently breaking existing automation.

issues.title: `eslams run --max-turns 0` / negative accepted; zero-turn run is match_valid_for_scoring: true
issues.criterion: Reject zero/negative turn caps before output creation; test that no scoring-valid empty run is emitted. Resolve jointly with #102.

issues.title: `eslams core budgets --json` (documented) exits 1: gomoku and pentago exceed Core prompt-token budgets
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Budget-check exit 1 is correct for an exceeded enforced budget. Reduce prompt usage or deliberately revise budget thresholds; do not force a green diagnostic without a documented decision.

issues.title: sample_runs/model_eval_sample official_signed.eslams does not validate under its documented command (official-bundle); docs inconsistent
issues.criterion: Document and test the actual intended fixture validation profile/key trust. A fixture signature is not live Official evidence; do not loosen Official validation to make an example pass.

issues.title: pip install from GitHub source archive (tag tarball / Download ZIP / git archive) fails: 'cannot build Core without immutable source provenance'
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: The immutable-provenance refusal is deliberate. Support source archives only with authenticated embedded provenance, or document Git/wheel installation; never fabricate a commit or weaken fail-closed provenance.

issues.title: README `eslams models update --providers ...` overwrites tracked models.generated.json and shrinks it ~80% (8762 -> 1697)
issues.criterion: Live model refresh must preserve the source registry or use explicit separate generated output/reviewed diff; test partial provider refresh cannot silently shrink the full registry.

issues.title: Arena start example in README fails after draft PR #21 (fail-closed session secret); README and CHANGELOG not updated
issues.criterion: Treat README, environment names and changelog as #21 acceptance criteria.

issues.title: Draft PRs #19 and #21 give contradictory README upload guidance (private runner bundle vs public replay package)
issues.criterion: Revised canonical guidance must distinguish private runner/auditor bundles from public replay packages; withdrawal of conflicting drafts also resolves this PR-only report.

issues.title: Dependency caps cryptography<47 and pytest<9 on main block fixes for known advisories (see draft PR #51)
issues.criterion: Close after audited compatible dependency bounds and supported-Python CI permit the reviewed fixes; raising caps alone is not evidence of safe declared floors.

issues.title: Open PR set (#13-#53) has 20 conflicting pairs and cannot be merged in arbitrary order; landing order needed
issues.criterion: Close when the retained/revised subset has a tested integration order and superseded proposals are withdrawn. A mergeable flag is insufficient; no need to merge every current branch.

issues.title: Draft PR #52 env-var coverage test fails once #21 lands alongside #40 (.env.example missing #21 variables)
issues.criterion: Update those PR acceptance criteria together; include #184 debug-observation documentation.

issues.title: Data loss: artifact public-export, publish export and fixtures replay delete the --out directory before validating input (--out . deletes the current directory)
issues.criterion: Validate inputs and canonical source/destination relationships first; refuse dangerous/preexisting destinations by default; stage output atomically. Test current directory, ancestor, source directory, symlink aliases and existing unrelated-file preservation for every affected command.
issues.evidence: tests/test_output_safety.py; publication, fixture and runner artifact regressions pass

issues.title: `eslams replay --output` and `core golden --out` overwrite the input artifact without warning
issues.criterion: Reject input/output aliasing, directories and unintended existing outputs before writing; test replay and golden exports preserve source bytes with explicit overwrite behavior only when safe.
issues.evidence: tests/test_output_safety.py: source/file/hardlink preservation, explicit overwrite, replay extra-argument error; 54 relevant tests pass; changed sources Ruff and mypy pass

issues.title: 6 of 50 advertised arenas cannot be run from the CLI (bridge, dou-dizhu, mahjong, leduc-holdem, limit-texas-holdem, no-limit-texas-holdem): raw traceback, no per-seat agent option
issues.criterion: Add an explicit per-seat agent mapping, or give actionable unsupported-mode errors and accurate capability docs. Run an actual supported CLI match for each affected multi-seat game.

issues.title: Missing or corrupt inputs to publish export, plan and official merge exit 0 and produce valid-looking output (unknown arena silently replaced)
issues.criterion: Missing/corrupt input, unknown arena and absent required plans must fail clearly without producing a valid-looking bundle; test source validation before output creation and no fabricated unknown-arena replacements.

issues.title: Artifacts produced by Core 0.2.0 to 0.5.0 fail validation on 0.5.1 and later (terminal outcome mismatch), with no compatibility note
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Choose tested legacy read support versus an explicit unsupported-version boundary. Preserve modern strict validation and Official authority; do not accept invalid historical outcomes merely to make old artifacts green.

issues.title: Plain local runs report per_case_scoring_eligible false and attempt_ledger_incomplete since 0.6.0; docs example shows true
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Define local play validity, scoring eligibility, provider-attempt completeness and publication authority separately. Empty provider ledger on keyless local play must not invent provider receipts or Official evidence.

issues.title: Licensing disclosure question: GPL-3.0+ `chess` dependency (via `python-chess`) in MIT-licensed eslams-core is not mentioned in docs
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Repository owner should review third-party license disclosure and distribution obligations. Record the chosen disclosure/dependency policy; this review makes no legal determination and does not automatically change the Core license.

issues.title: SECURITY.md advertises GitHub private vulnerability reporting, but the feature is disabled on the repository
issues.criterion: Close after the repository owner enables and verifies private vulnerability reporting, or replaces the advertised route with a tested private contact. Settings changes are distinct from code changes.

issues.title: Hugging Face namespace `ElectronicSlams` does not exist while open draft PRs (#13, #17, #18, #19) reference it (namespace squatting risk)
issues.criterion: The reviewed quickstart already marks HF as pending, so lack of that caveat is not reproduced. Reserving an org is an owner/operations task, not a Core patch. Recheck current namespace availability only when choosing rollout; do not assert the 2026-09-23 snapshot is current.

issues.title: Draft Hugging Face dataset card and placeholder collection URL contain links that return 404
issues.criterion: Remove placeholder collection/dataset links from publishable cards, or keep them explicitly unlinked/pending. Close obsolete draft-only defects when the relevant proposal is replaced; creating a collection is not required.

issues.title: Packaging hygiene: 0.4.0 and 0.5.0 sdists ship internal planning files; fixtures and bundles contain developer local paths
issues.criterion: Audit fresh wheel/sdist allowlists and public fixtures for planning files/local paths. Old published packages are immutable historical evidence; document any retained historical leak/remediation rather than claim a new build changes old bytes.

issues.title: Hanabi: non-terminal state with no legal actions; 27 of 200 built-in random-vs-random matches end as agent_crash
issues.criterion: Test reachable Hanabi no-action states; model legal discard/play/hint or legitimate game termination without attributing engine deadlock to agent_crash. Pair with cooperative metadata and clue-token rules.

issues.title: Shogi and Xiangqi: moves that leave the mover's own king in check are legal (catalogue says faithful; differs from Fairy-Stockfish)
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Choose faithful king-safety rules or an explicitly named compact variant. Catalogued faithful claims require correction either way; preserve prior arena versions rather than relabeling old results.

issues.title: Cribbage: hand and crib scoring deviates from standard rules (ace-high runs, no double-run multiplicity, crib flush, nob never scored)
issues.criterion: Use small authoritative cribbage scoring examples for ace-low runs, run multiplicity, crib flush and nob; preserve arena-version boundaries for changed scores.

issues.title: Cribbage: dealer and crib fixed to player_2 with no alternation (random play wins 67 vs 309), headline score is player_1 only
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Fixed dealer assignment and player_1 score are fairness/product-contract choices as well as possible rule defects. Declare alternation and result aggregation, then implement/version only the chosen rule set.

issues.title: Pentago: five-in-a-row made by the placement is not a win if the same move's rotation breaks it
issues.criterion: Verify Pentago win timing against the declared rules: placement-phase wins require correct treatment even if rotation would break the line. Add minimal winning/dual-win examples, not a wholesale arena rewrite. Rules reference: [Mindtwister publisher rulebook, mirrored by retailer](https://zacatrus.es/media/instrucciones/Pentago_Reglas_zacatrus.pdf).

issues.title: Texas hold'em (limit, no-limit) and Leduc: multiway showdown tie gives equal shares to strictly worse hands
issues.criterion: Only best tied showdown hands share a pot; test multiway tied-best plus strictly worse hand and side-pot behavior with deterministic legal examples.

issues.title: First-price sealed-bid auction: ties always go to player_1, winner utility floored at 0, and winner can contradict scores
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Auction allocation winner need not maximize bidder utility. Separate documented tie-break policy, potentially negative utility and outcome fields; do not redefine auction winner as the highest utility scorer.

issues.title: Othello: max_turns=64 counts passes, so games with passes end early while a legal move remains
issues.criterion: Use actual Othello placement/pass semantics for a declared horizon. Test pass-heavy games retain legal play until true terminal or explicitly marked truncation.

issues.title: Runner: float (3.0) and bool (True) actions pass legality then fail or are accepted inconsistently; forfeit and fallback policies ignored
issues.criterion: Validate action shapes/types at the boundary, rejecting bool/nonintegral forms consistently before indexing. Test illegal-action and fallback/forfeit policy and receipt provenance.

issues.title: Runner: max_turns below natural game length yields a scoring-valid run with no outcome and 0/0 scores (extends #59)
issues.criterion: Mark externally truncated nonterminal runs invalid/incomplete for the agreed scoring contract; preserve replay/diagnostic output and distinguish a declared arena horizon outcome from runner truncation.

issues.title: 0.5.1 changed game behavior in 15 arenas without bumping arena version strings (plus fixed pre-0.5.1 backgammon bear-off crash)
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Inventory exact behavior changes and assign correct future arena versions. Keep historical rules identifiable; do not rewrite prior run hashes or claim all historical comparisons have identical semantics.

issues.title: PLATFORM_CONTRACTS.md CLI walkthrough fails: `arena step --state session_state.json` (saved `arena start` output) crashes with KeyError: state_id
issues.criterion: Accept only the documented saved session envelope/response shape or fix the walkthrough. Test the copied CLI start-to-step sequence with required explicit secret configuration.

issues.title: eslams replay HTML overflows a 390 px viewport for most non-chess arenas (gomoku 788 px, nine-mens-morris 1277 px, backgammon 1113 px)
issues.criterion: Constrain layout and preserve usable board scrolling; check representative renderer families.

issues.title: eslams replay HTML: all move buttons precede Prev/Play/Next in tab order (Play is Tab stop 75 for chess), arrow keys do nothing, focus drops to body
issues.criterion: Put controls first, preserve focus and announce changes; pair #192/#193.

issues.title: eslams replay HTML shows a raw JSON dump instead of a board for hanabi, blackjack, mancala and most card, physics and negotiation arenas
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Decide the supported renderer coverage. A truthful structured JSON fallback may be acceptable; do not promise a board for every game unless it is actually supported and tested.

issues.title: eslams replay HTML labels numeric action 0 as "move" (tic-tac-toe cell 0, connect-four column 0)
issues.criterion: Treat action 0 as a real value, not falsy/missing; test cell/column-zero labels in rendered move lists.

issues.title: PyPI long description uses relative links (docs/, CHANGELOG.md, sample_runs/) that resolve to the PyPI project page
issues.criterion: Render PyPI README with absolute repository/tag-aware links and inspect generated metadata, keeping local README navigation usable.

issues.title: README install: `pip install eslams-core` fails with externally-managed-environment on Debian 13 and the only venv recipe uses `python`, which does not exist
issues.criterion: Use python3 -m venv and python -m pip plus activation instructions; verify the guide on externally managed Debian Python without recommending system-package override flags.

issues.title: README/PLATFORM_CONTRACTS example `eslams plan official --suite public-smoke ...` always returns an empty plan (0 models, 0 cases) because no registry model has official_eval enabled
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Decide whether the historical Official planner remains supported. Either supply a truthful actionable registry/sample plan or reject/document the unsupported command; never enable all registry rows for Official evaluation to populate the plan.

issues.title: README/ARTIFACTS signing example uses placeholder `base64:...`; copied literally it crashes the run, and the 32-byte key format is documented nowhere
issues.criterion: Provide a safe throwaway 32-byte key-generation recipe and explicit base64/hex format errors. Test copied examples without real signing keys or granting Official authority.

issues.title: README says the package ships the TypeScript packages, but the PyPI wheel has none, the sdist only has sources, and npm has neither package
issues.criterion: Document wheel versus TypeScript source/publication honestly. Private flags do not make npm packages available or establish parity; test actual release contents.

issues.title: No CODE_OF_CONDUCT, issue templates or pull request template (GitHub community health 75%)
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Choose community templates/code-of-conduct intentionally. A community-health percentage is not itself a runtime defect; close as not planned with rationale or add the agreed minimal templates.

issues.title: README/CONTRIBUTING are POSIX-only (reading-only) and the Quick Start fails after the run when symlinks are unavailable (simulated Windows)
issues.criterion: Provide documented Windows equivalents and a safe latest-run fallback if symlink creation is unavailable; verify on native Windows before claiming support.

issues.title: docs/ARTIFACTS.md "Required structure" omits replay/index.html and timings/timings.json that every run writes
issues.criterion: Consolidate this narrow layout omission into #165. Close as duplicate only with an explicit parent link and complete coverage of replay/timing members; close parent after docs match generated artifacts.

issues.title: eslams fixtures artifact deletes unrelated files: sibling <stem>.eslams.d for dotted --out names and latest.eslams pointers in the output directory
issues.criterion: Output ownership must be explicit: avoid deleting sibling .eslams.d directories or unrelated latest pointers. Test dotted names, mixed outputs and existing files.

issues.title: eslams catalogue games: --include-help, --include-render and --include-animation are accepted but ignored (output byte-identical)
issues.criterion: Implement documented include flags or remove/reject unsupported flags; test semantic output differences without asserting every optional renderer is ready.

issues.title: eslams catalogue availability (text mode) prints 438,100 lines with only 100 distinct (model dropped); catalogue renderers shows an invented status=ready
issues.criterion: Preserve model identity in text rows and report renderer readiness from actual capabilities; test bounded distinct rows and truthful unavailable/partial statuses.

issues.title: eslams run creates runs/latest.eslams symlinks with absolute targets: copied or moved project directories get dangling or wrong pointers
issues.criterion: Use a relocatable relative latest pointer or manifest pointer; copy/move a run directory and verify the pointer follows the intended artifact.

issues.title: fixtures artifact: re-running into an existing file fails with FileExistsError traceback telling the user to pass --overwrite, which the subcommand rejects (0.4.0 replaced the file)
issues.criterion: Choose one documented overwrite/refusal API for fixtures and enforce it safely; re-run a fixture command into existing output and preserve bytes on refusal.

issues.title: Rock-paper-scissors and prisoners-dilemma: player_1's hidden commit is visible to player_2 in ActRequest.history, the provider prompt and session events (same for sealed-bid auction and goofspiel)
issues.criterion: Project action history/events per viewer and reveal simultaneous commitments only at the declared reveal phase. Test RPS, prisoners-dilemma, sealed auction and goofspiel through HTTP/provider/browser paths.

issues.title: Chess: arena ends games on claimable draws (board.outcome(claim_draw=True)), so a mate-in-1 at halfmove clock 99 or a twice-seen position is declared drawn before the mover plays
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Automatic acceptance of a claimable draw can be a declared benchmark variant. Implement explicit claim semantics if faithful chess is promised, or version/document the automatic-claim variant; preserve reproducibility.

issues.title: Paddle-ball: win condition (10 bounces) is unreachable within max_turns=160; a perfect player gets 4 bounces, score capped at 0.4
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Decide whether paddle-ball success is completion or a graded score. Align target, physics, horizon and catalogue with that decision; increasing a cap without versioning changes the benchmark.

issues.title: Negotiation: displayed private_reserve_share is never enforced (accept always legal, utilities ignore it) unlike bargaining
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: A private reserve can be a preference rather than a legality restriction. Define utilities and observation semantics before forbidding accept; close as documented non-issue if the current nonbinding preference is intentional.

issues.title: Ultimate tic-tac-toe: full-board end rule awards the win on local-board count instead of a draw (303 of 431 no-line playouts); catalogue says faithful/standard
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Choose standard ultimate-tic-tac-toe draws or the local-board-count variant. Correct the faithful/standard label or version the implementation; do not change historical semantics in place.

issues.title: Nine men's morris: max_turns=120 ends 15% of random games as 0.5/0.5 turn_limit draws while play is still decisive (OpenSpiel not terminal); catalogue says faithful/standard
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: A finite game horizon is a legitimate benchmark rule when declared. Keep or change it through explicit rules/versioning; disagreement with OpenSpiel alone does not prove a terminal draw is invalid.

issues.title: Catalogue help.exampleActions: 42 of 50 games have no example token that is a legal action (default token "0"), and step_session rejects it with turn.failed
issues.criterion: Catalogue examples must be legal for a declared reproducible initial context or clearly schematic. Test each advertised example through the public step contract.

issues.title: Alien-shooter: a bullet can share a cell with an alien without a hit and then pass through it (hits resolved before the alien descent)
issues.criterion: Fix bullet/alien collision sequencing using small deterministic crossing/overlap examples; version the corrected physics and reassess #134 afterwards.

issues.title: Alien-shooter: the only win (wave_cleared) is reachable in 2 of 125 seeds; exhaustive search shows 98.4% of seeds cannot be won
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Unwinnable seeds do not alone invalidate a solo-score task. Fix collision mechanics (#133) first; declare graded score versus guaranteed-completion goals and reassess solvability under the corrected physics.

issues.title: Boxing-style-arena and ice-hockey-style-arena: catalogued as solo_score (no opponent, no winner) but are alternating two-player games with winner, draws and a hidden opponent policy
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Correct solo/head-to-head metadata to the actual seat/outcome contract, or implement the intended solo rules under a new version. Hidden opponent policy needs an explicit reproducibility/visibility contract.

issues.title: eslams run crashes after the match with UnicodeEncodeError when an agent or model public_explanation contains a lone UTF-16 surrogate (valid JSON); partial artifact left, no result
issues.criterion: Reject or deterministically sanitize lone surrogates at agent input before serialization; test no partial committed artifact or fabricated explanation appears.

issues.title: NaN confidence from an HTTP agent is accepted and written as bare NaN into artifact JSON; validate says valid, strict JSON parsers fail
issues.criterion: Reject nonfinite numeric values in agent/runtime/output contracts; use strict JSON serialization and schema fixtures across Python and TypeScript.

issues.title: eslams run crashes after the match when the system clock is before 1980 or after 2107 (ZIP timestamp range); empty archive left
issues.criterion: Choose deterministic valid archive timestamp handling, test clocks outside ZIP range, and stage archives so failures leave no installed empty archive.

issues.title: Concurrent eslams run into one --output-dir intermittently exits 1 with FileExistsError/FileNotFoundError in _replace_latest_link, losing the result JSON
issues.criterion: Make latest-pointer replacement atomic and concurrent-safe; each completed run must retain its summary and archive. Test two independent writers to one directory.

issues.title: Reading-only (Windows): write_text without newline="\n" makes artifact bytes, artifact_id and schema bundle hash differ from Linux
issues.criterion: Write canonical LF bytes explicitly independent of platform; compare schema/artifact hashes on native Windows and Linux. gitattributes (#45) alone does not change runtime writes.

issues.title: No cap on agent response size or public_explanation: a 100 MB explanation is accepted and expands to a 701 MB artifact tree (650 MB RSS); gzip bomb reaches 960 MB RSS
issues.criterion: Bound wire bytes, decoded body, explanation size and decompression before full buffering; enforce per-attempt and aggregate budgets without reproducing the huge-memory attack during tests.

issues.title: Provider adapters ignore error, refusal and finish_reason fields: errors in a 200 body are not retried or classified, refusals look like schema errors, receipt finish_reason/finish_status always null
issues.criterion: Classify 200-body provider errors, refusals and finish statuses explicitly, preserving physical attempt/usage receipts and retry policy. Test fixture responses for all supported adapters, not fabricated live success.

issues.title: eslams providers models --provider openai --live prints ok:false with an empty model list and no reason (missing key, DNS failure and HTTP error look identical)
issues.criterion: Return structured discovery failures with safe provider/status/retry metadata; distinguish missing key, DNS, authorization, empty success and transport failure without echoing keys/URLs.

issues.title: Low file-descriptor limit makes eslams run exit 0 with a valid-looking summary but an empty 22-byte archive on Python 3.12+ (Path.rglob swallows EMFILE)
issues.criterion: Injected EMFILE must propagate as failure before a success summary/final archive; verify on Python versions where pathlib can suppress traversal errors and pair with atomic output handling.

issues.title: Backgammon: game stays non-terminal with no legal action for either player (3 of 3000 random playouts); Runner records it as agent_crash with no outcome
issues.criterion: A blocked backgammon turn can require a pass and fresh roll; both players having no moves under the current roll does not prove game over. Test pass/re-roll, true terminal and malformed-state distinctions.

issues.title: Backgammon: bear-off legal moves allow bearing off a nearer checker with a larger die while a farther checker remains, and the use-both-dice / larger-die rules are not enforced (4.0% of sampled states)
issues.criterion: Enforce the declared backgammon bear-off, both-dice and larger-die rules with tiny legal-state fixtures, preserving the compact board variant/version separately.

issues.title: Battleship: player_2's hidden fleet is drawn only from cells not used by player_1 (0 overlaps in 20,000 seeds vs 33% expected), so a player's own board leaks information about the opponent's
issues.criterion: Generate opponent fleets independently under the declared independent-board rules; use deterministic structural tests rather than relying only on aggregate overlap frequencies.

issues.title: Gin Rummy: deadwood evaluator treats the ace as high (Q-K-A is a run, A-2-3 is not) and lets one card count in a set and a run, so knock legality and scoring are wrong
issues.criterion: Compute gin deadwood with disjoint meld selection and the declared ace rule; test overlapping set/run alternatives and knock thresholds.

issues.title: Card games (hearts, spades, bridge, mahjong, dou-dizhu): session responses list the model seat's legal actions, which are its private hand, in browser-streamable fields
issues.criterion: Public session projections must never enumerate another seat's private legal cards. Project legal actions/viewer-specific descriptors across state, events and HTTP responses; signed full-state envelopes remain service-only unless encrypted/opaque.

issues.title: Gin Rummy: drawing the last stock card ends the hand at once with an 8-card hand and scores it on deadwood (pagat: hand is cancelled when the stock reaches two cards)
issues.criterion: Implement the declared stock-exhaustion/cancellation rule while preserving valid hand size; test last-draw, discard and scoring transitions.

issues.title: Goofspiel and mahjong: catalogue says drawAllowed=false and winnerRequired=true, but about 9% and 6% of random games end with winner None
issues.criterion: Make drawAllowed/winnerRequired reflect actual permitted terminal outcomes or change rules under a new version. Do not fabricate a winner to satisfy metadata.

issues.title: README and catalogue label backgammon, battleship and crazy-eights as `faithful` although they are compact variants (5 checkers per side, 5x5 board with three one-cell ships, 5-card deal)
issues.criterion: Label compact backgammon/battleship/crazy-eights variants honestly and document exact rules; marketing them as faithful requires implementing full rules under separate versions.

issues.title: eslams fixtures artifact: --out names with a space, accent, + or parentheses crash with a run_id ValueError traceback (worked in 0.4.0)
issues.criterion: Decouple arbitrary output filenames from the path-safe internal run ID, preserving confinement. Test spaces/Unicode/+/( ) without accepting traversal in internal IDs.

issues.title: Empty RUNNER_ARTIFACT_SIGNING_KEY_ID: eslams run exits 0 and writes a signed artifact that always fails validation (key_id must be a non-empty string)
issues.criterion: Reject empty/malformed signing key IDs before run output; test every emitted signed artifact verifies under the expected configured key and empty env values fail early.

issues.title: eslams providers preflight (offline and --live) accepts providers with no adapter and asks for "environment variable unknown"; eslams run then raises KeyError
issues.criterion: Preflight must use the actual adapter registry and return unsupported-provider reasons; no unknown env-var placeholder or passing unsupported adapter.

issues.title: Catalogue marks 72 embedding and reranker models launch_status ready with Arena enabled; the same OpenAI embedding model is not_game_agent_supported under openai
issues.criterion: Disable game-agent/Arena readiness for embedding/reranker-only models based on real adapter capabilities; test provider aliases and model capability rows.

issues.title: eslams catalogue models: public_slug collides for two together-ai bge-base models and 181 slugs contain @, * or ~
issues.criterion: A public_slug collision is actionable; @ and ~ are not inherently illegal URL path characters. Define an injective stable slug grammar and encoding/redirect policy, then fix collisions and only prohibited characters.

issues.title: README and REGISTRY_AVAILABLE_MODELS.md say Core tracks 90 namespaces and 1926 rows, but eslams models list and catalogue models serve 8762 rows from 259 providers
issues.criterion: Generate current registry counts from the published catalogue and explain source versus routable adapter coverage; do not delete registry rows to match an old README count.

issues.title: eslams run --overwrite has no effect: run ids are always unique and there is no way to choose one, so the documented "existing artifact paths are refused" never applies
issues.criterion: A no-op overwrite option is an API/documentation mismatch, not evidence that current unique-ID runs overwrite prior artifacts. Remove/deprecate it or add a deliberately specified named-run behavior; default refusal remains safe.

issues.title: docs/ARTIFACTS.md Runner Signatures omits that a signed artifact fails validation (runner_signature_unverified) without RUNNER_ARTIFACT_VERIFY_PUBLIC_KEY
issues.criterion: Document verify-public-key configuration and trusted key authority; test signing/verification with a throwaway key and explain that verified self-signing alone is not Official provenance.

issues.title: `eslams validate` and `eslams replay` on an existing file that is not an .eslams archive fail with `FileNotFoundError: <that path>`
issues.criterion: Distinguish existing unsupported/corrupt files from missing files with actionable errors; test archive/content identification without reading unrelated data.
issues.evidence: tests/test_archive_safety.py: preflight member/byte bounds, portable traversal/alias/link rejection, CRC/interrupt cleanup and all archive consumers; existing nonarchives get ValueError rather than FileNotFoundError

issues.title: Most CLI options have no `--help` text (135 of 143), including `run --max-turns`, `--on-agent-error`, `--on-illegal-action`, `--execution-profile` and `--shard-*`
issues.criterion: Document actual CLI semantics and safe defaults in help for meaningful options; test high-risk parameters and copyable examples rather than locking every help string.

issues.title: README Quick Start: after `eslams run --expanded` the `runs/latest.eslams` pointer is removed but the next documented step is `eslams validate runs/latest.eslams`
issues.criterion: After --expanded, show the actual expanded artifact path or correct pointer behavior; execute the full documented run-to-validate walkthrough.

issues.title: README "Artifact Anatomy" lists 20 files; a default run writes 26 (omits public/*, public_reasoning, scores/official_result.json, timings, validation summary)
issues.criterion: Generate or verify canonical artifact anatomy for relevant profiles, including public/reasoning/score/timing/validation outputs and optionality; absorb #120.

issues.title: README lists `arena.auto_advanced` as an Arena event type; Core never emits it and docs/PLATFORM_CONTRACTS.md says it is reserved
issues.criterion: Mark arena.auto_advanced as reserved unless implemented; align README, schema and consumer expectations without emitting a fake event.

issues.title: CHANGELOG v0.5.0 states 12 solo / 29 head-to-head / 9 multi-seat games; since 0.5.1 the catalogue has 13 / 31 / 6 and the 0.5.1 entry does not mention the reclassification
issues.criterion: Keep the historical v0.5.0 count accurate for v0.5.0; add the actual v0.5.1 reclassification and version migration note. Do not rewrite history to present-day counts.

issues.title: CONTRIBUTING.md lists a bare `tsc -p packages/core-contracts/tsconfig.json` that cannot run after the documented setup (no TypeScript installed; CI also checks core-lite)
issues.criterion: Document a reproducible TypeScript installation and checks for both packages, plus version-matched Python typing commands; verify from a clean developer environment.

issues.title: examples/random_agent.py is not random: it always returns `legal_actions[0]`, identical to the built-in `first-legal` agent
issues.criterion: Rename example to first-legal or implement seeded random choice consistent with its name and documented determinism; test behavior with multiple legal options.

issues.title: GitHub release notes for v0.4.0 and v0.5.1 contain literal `\n` sequences and render as one run-on paragraph; v0.4.0 also says PyPI upload was not done
issues.criterion: Review and render intended historical release-note text, then correct only factual formatting/status errors through the repository owner. Preserve historical chronology; a new changelog does not rewrite remote releases.

issues.title: Wheel and sdist ship no `py.typed` marker although the project is checked with `mypy --strict`, so downstream mypy treats `eslams` as untyped
issues.criterion: Ship py.typed in wheel/sdist and validate downstream mypy sees the installed package as typed from outside the checkout.

issues.title: `eslams --version` and `-V` are not supported (argparse: "the following arguments are required: command")
issues.criterion: Expose the actual installed distribution version consistently for --version/-V and module entry; test without creating output or requiring secrets.

issues.title: `eslams replay <artifact> <anything>` silently accepts an undocumented second positional and ignores it (a typo still exits 0)
issues.criterion: Remove/reject the ignored positional argument or document and implement it; a typo must not silently look successful.
issues.evidence: tests/test_output_safety.py: source/file/hardlink preservation, explicit overwrite, replay extra-argument error; 54 relevant tests pass; changed sources Ruff and mypy pass

issues.title: `eslams catalogue games --json | head -1` exits 1 with a `BrokenPipeError` traceback (also `models list`, `core budgets`)
issues.criterion: Handle BrokenPipeError as normal pipe termination at the real entry point without obscuring actual command failures; test piped output with an early-closing consumer.
issues.evidence: Shared console/module CLI wrapper reports expected input/file errors, preserves unexpected failures, supports ESLAMS_DEBUG and handles closed output pipes. Six subprocess/error regressions plus output/archive regressions passed (30 cases); installed-wheel verification remains a final gate.

issues.title: `eslams run --shard-index 5 --shard-count 2` (also index -1, count 0) is accepted and the artifact validates as `valid: true`
issues.criterion: Reject invalid shard ranges before output; record the valid shard identity and test no scoring-valid artifacts are written for illegal selections.

issues.title: Interrupting `eslams run` (Ctrl-C / SIGINT) leaves a half-written `run_*.eslams.d` directory with no `manifest.json`
issues.criterion: Stage artifact trees/archive and commit atomically; distinguish explicit failed/partial diagnostic state from complete artifacts and clean temporary writes on interrupt.

issues.title: `eslams runner session-create/step/snapshot/close` cannot work from the CLI: each command is a new process, so `session-step` fails with `KeyError: unknown runner session`
issues.criterion: Choose persistent authenticated service CLI commands, explicit snapshot import/export, or remove unsupported process-local session commands. Do not imply an in-memory store survives separate CLI processes.

issues.title: Shogi start position has rook and bishop on swapped files (player_1 rook on 8h, bishop on 2h; standard is bishop 8h, rook 2h)
issues.criterion: Correct standard orientation and differential opening legal moves; pair #94 and bump rules version.

issues.title: Hanabi is catalogued `head_to_head` with `winnerRequired: true`, but only 1 of 100 random-vs-random matches ends with a winner
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Hanabi is cooperative; a required head-to-head winner is a wrong product contract. Agree cooperative scoring/seat metadata, remove invented winner requirements, and version changes coherently with #93/#182. Rules reference: [Hanabi publisher rulebook](https://cdn.svc.asmodee.net/production-asmodeees/uploads/2023/06/Hanabi_Reglamento_ES.pdf).

issues.title: Per-action time budget is enforced with SIGALRM on the main thread only: from a worker thread a 0.3 s budget lets a slow agent run for 4 s
issues.criterion: Enforce elapsed deadlines in worker threads and on supported operating systems, including read/stream time; test bounded execution and cancellation without assuming SIGALRM works everywhere.

issues.title: `eslams replay` renders a content-tampered artifact with exit 0 and no warning, although `eslams validate` reports `valid: false` (hash mismatch)
issues.criterion: Render tampered/unverified artifacts only under an explicit diagnostic mode with visible trust state, or refuse by default. #26 extraction/HTML changes do not perform artifact validation.

issues.title: Hanabi: discarding is legal while all 8 clue tokens are available (standard rules forbid it)
issues.criterion: Align discard legality with the declared Hanabi rules and clue-token count, coordinating deadlock/scoring metadata fixes; test full-clue and nonfull-clue cases. Rules reference: [Hanabi publisher rulebook](https://cdn.svc.asmodee.net/production-asmodeees/uploads/2023/06/Hanabi_Reglamento_ES.pdf).

issues.title: `eslams validate` / `replay` / `public-export` extract the whole archive before judging it: a 300 KB archive expands to 300 MiB in /tmp (no size or member-count cap)
issues.criterion: Preflight and stream-enforce member count, per-member/total expanded bytes and accepted path/member types; clean up on CRC/I/O/security failures. #26 path confinement alone cannot close this.
issues.evidence: tests/test_archive_safety.py: preflight member/byte bounds, portable traversal/alias/link rejection, CRC/interrupt cleanup and all archive consumers; existing nonarchives get ValueError rather than FileNotFoundError

issues.title: `ESLAMS_ENABLE_DEBUG_OBSERVATION` is read by Core but documented nowhere (README, docs, SECURITY, CONTRIBUTING, CHANGELOG)
issues.criterion: Document debug-observation exposure and disable it for untrusted/public clients; test projections so enabling server diagnostics cannot silently make public state private.

issues.title: The published 0.6.1 sdist cannot run its own test suite: `test_wheel_export_matches_source_without_git_checkout` runs `git rev-parse HEAD` and fails outside a git checkout
issues.criterion: Run shipped sdist tests with authentic embedded provenance and no Git checkout; remove test-only Git assumptions while retaining runtime provenance validation.

issues.title: `eslams plan official|battlefield|public-match --shard-count N` is unbounded: N=1,000,000 prints a 115 MB plan for a suite with 0 cases; 0 and negatives are silently clamped to 1
issues.criterion: Reject invalid/excessive shard counts, bound plan expansion by meaningful workload limits, and never silently clamp a malformed request into apparent success.

issues.title: `eslams agent serve --port 65536` is accepted; the banner prints `http://127.0.0.1:65536` but the socket listens on a different random port
issues.criterion: Validate port range before socket creation and print the actual bound address/port; test out-of-range values and explicit ephemeral port if intentionally supported.

issues.title: Declared minimum dependency versions are not security-tested: installing the floors (cryptography 42.0.0, fastapi 0.115.0) gives 29 known vulnerabilities
issues.criterion: Audit compatible declared floors and current resolution, distinguishing runtime reachability from raw advisory count; update constraints or documented supported matrix with scoped reviewed exceptions.

issues.title: Draft PR #42: the `ruff-format` pre-commit hook would reformat 37 files that already exist on main, and `pre-commit` is not in the dev extras
issues.criterion: Choose baseline formatting policy, then align hook installation and CI.

issues.title: Draft PR #26 changes the default bind of `eslams agent serve` and `AgentServer.run()` from 0.0.0.0 to 127.0.0.1 but adds no CHANGELOG entry
issues.criterion: Document loopback default and explicit remote/container --host opt-in; verify expected container workflows. Close when revised #26 lands or is withdrawn, rather than reporting an unmerged default as released.

issues.title: eslams replay HTML: the Details panel always shows chess rows (`FEN n/a`, `Validation check=n/a checkmate=n/a legal=n/a`) for every game
issues.criterion: Render game-specific details or omit inapplicable chess-only rows; verify chess and several non-chess examples.

issues.title: eslams replay HTML: move-list buttons are 18 px high (go: 121 buttons at 390 and 768 px viewports), below the 24 px WCAG 2.2 AA target size
issues.criterion: 18 px alone is insufficient to conclude WCAG failure because spacing and other exceptions matter. Measure effective target spacing on the rendered page; fix compact targets where needed and verify keyboard access separately.

issues.title: eslams replay HTML: non-chess boards are plain divs with bare letters (no role, no aria-label), so assistive technology gets no board structure
issues.criterion: Use appropriate board semantics and accessible names/coordinates for rendered games; validate keyboard/screen-reader reading order in representative board and fallback views.

issues.title: `eslams run --time-budget-ms 0` and negative values are accepted without error and the run is scoring-valid
issues.criterion: Reject nonpositive time budgets before output; test enforced bounded action attempts and no scoring-valid impossible configuration.

issues.title: Arena `initial_state(seed)` does not validate the seed type: float seed 1.5 is truncated to 1 in metadata and `rng_commitment` changes after the first move
issues.criterion: Require the contract seed type/range without bool/float/string coercion surprises; test state hash/rng commitment stability across public creation and step paths.

issues.title: Default and README Anthropic model claude-sonnet-4-20250514 is retired by Anthropic (2026-06-15); preflight still reports ok:true
issues.criterion: Choose a currently supported Anthropic default after verifying the provider's current model lifecycle; update registry/docs and classify retired/not-found outcomes honestly. Live checks need separately authorized test credentials.

issues.title: providers preflight --live and providers models --live read only page 1 of the Models API: Anthropic (20) and Gemini (50) models beyond it are reported not visible
issues.criterion: Follow documented pagination with termination/error limits for each relevant provider; use multi-page fixtures and return full discovery or a clear partial/error state.

issues.title: A trailing newline, CRLF or space in the provider API key env var fails every request with 'Illegal header value' (exit 0); non-ASCII key crashes with UnicodeEncodeError
issues.criterion: Normalize only allowed surrounding whitespace or reject malformed credentials early; never print key values, and test CRLF/non-ASCII invalid input safely.

issues.title: ProviderRuntimeConfig.timeout_ms has no effect: a 1000 ms total timeout lets a 3 s response (and a 6.7 s trickled body) succeed
issues.criterion: Enforce an absolute attempt deadline across connection, read and streamed chunks, then record timeout accurately; test slow/trickled local responses and thread mode.

issues.title: Retry-After from a 429/5xx response is slept without any cap when max_retries > 0 (86400 s header sleeps a day from a worker thread)
issues.criterion: Bound Retry-After by retry/deadline budgets; cancellation must remain responsive and attempts indexed correctly. Test large/malformed/HTTP-date headers without real long sleeps.

issues.title: Windows checkout with core.autocrlf=true (no .gitattributes): shipped sample publication bundles fail 'eslams publish validate' and 2 tests fail (simulated)
issues.criterion: Validate a fresh native Windows checkout with ordinary autocrlf configuration and packaged samples; gitattributes must preserve exact hashed bytes without regenerating trusted signatures.

issues.title: Live 'providers preflight' fails for README example models gpt-5-mini and gpt-5-nano (128-token cap consumed by reasoning, reported as schema mismatch)
issues.criterion: Use model-appropriate response/reasoning budgets in preflight and runtime; classify incomplete/refusal distinctly from schema errors. Any retries must have genuine separate attempt receipts and no fabricated completion.

issues.title: 'eslams validate --profile official-case' fails with misleading action_provenance_incomplete when official_eval run had no --case-id
issues.criterion: Reject missing official-case identity before execution/validation with a specific error; do not infer a hidden case or weaken provenance completeness.

issues.title: Limit/no-limit Texas hold'em and Leduc: a fold that leaves all remaining players matched does not close the betting round, so the bettor can bet again (about 45% of random games)
issues.criterion: Close matched betting rounds correctly after folds and test seat order, pot contributions and repeated betting legality in all three affected poker arenas.

issues.title: Core-lite (TypeScript) state hashes never match Python for the same game and seed, although core capabilities reports core_lite_ts verifiedAgainst 0.6.1
issues.criterion: Add cross-language semantic and canonical-byte fixtures for each advertised supported game/seed/action/outcome; fix numeric serialization and action hashing. Remove unproven verifiedAgainst claims until fixtures pass.

issues.title: Core-lite applyAction rejects the contract action shapes "0" and {actionId:"0"} as illegal; Python core_step accepts them
issues.criterion: Normalize the same public string/object action shapes in Python and TypeScript; test contract-level parity with preserved action IDs and hashes.

issues.title: Core-lite createInitialState turns seed "0" and every non-numeric seed into seed 1 (Python seed 0 is a different game)
issues.criterion: Preserve seed zero and reject invalid seeds with the same contract errors as Python; do not coerce arbitrary strings into a valid seed.

issues.title: Solo-score games record winner player_2 (a seat that does not exist) in score.json and the public summary; the result contract says solo winner must be null
issues.criterion: Solo results must keep winner null and use the documented score/outcome schema; test non-existent-seat winners are impossible across score/public/publication outputs.

issues.title: eslams publish export --artifacts <runs dir> exports the newest run twice (latest.eslams symlink plus the real file): duplicate proof rows and double-counted token usage, bundle validates
issues.criterion: Enumerate distinct artifacts by canonical identity, avoiding latest pointers/aliases without merging genuinely distinct runs; test deduplicated proof rows and exact usage totals.

issues.title: eslams publish export is not deterministic: proof_index.jsonl embeds the absolute input path, so identical artifacts give different bundle hashes from different directories
issues.criterion: Remove absolute local input paths from canonical publication proof rows; compare byte-identical bundles from different roots while retaining private diagnostics separately.

issues.title: eslams publish export always writes an empty provider_model_rows.jsonl (documented provider/model rows) and cost_unavailable pricing even when the artifact has provider receipts
issues.criterion: Record and approve the intended contract, then implement/version or close as intentional/not planned with evidence: Decide whether provider_model_rows is a supported output. Populate it deterministically from validated receipts and reviewed price cards, or deprecate/document it. Missing cost data must remain unavailable, never invented.

issues.title: docs/PROTOCOL.md says invalid JSON from an /act agent is retried once and then marked invalid_action; Core does not retry and records agent_crash
issues.criterion: Make malformed /act JSON classification and retry semantics truthful and explicit. Do not add a retry simply because stale prose promises one; any physical retry must preserve attempt provenance.

issues.title: README and sample_runs/README cite curated chess battle run_d48ff364a0b949df (composer-2.5 vs grok-build-0.1) in sample_runs/model_battle_sample, but the directory holds run_eeab67d58b994ca7, a first-legal vs first-legal run
issues.criterion: Correct stale battle sample IDs/opponent claims to the actual tracked artifact and validate each documented command/profile; take the narrow fix from #22 without its warehouse runtime module.

issues.title: Four tests use cwd-relative fixture paths: pytest run from tests/ or any directory other than the repo root fails with FileNotFoundError
issues.criterion: Resolve fixtures from the installed/test source context rather than cwd; run targeted and full tests from root, tests directory and a clean outside directory.

issues.title: Core-lite applyAction on a terminal state returns illegal_action_for_state with recoverable true; Python core_step returns terminal_state with recoverable false
issues.criterion: Use the same terminal-state error/recoverability contract in Python and TypeScript; test terminal action calls without mutating state.

issues.title: Core-lite applyAction throws a raw TypeError for a malformed state (missing public_state, short or non-array board) where Python core_step returns an ok:false error response
issues.criterion: Validate malformed state shapes and return structured contract errors rather than raw exceptions; test board shape, absent fields and invalid game identity in both runtimes.
